<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/page-link/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Microservices-only AutoPay subscription-management proxy. Connect terminates merchant authentication using private API key, Basic auth, or Keycloak JWT, resolves the merchant tenant, forwards the request to AutoPay with Merchant-Id, and returns AutoPay's response body and status to the merchant.

Returns the subscription's current customer-facing hosted-page link without rotating it, so a link already in the customer's hands keeps working. Use regenerate-page-token instead when the old link must be revoked.
Returns the customer's current self-service link **without changing it**, so a link the customer already has keeps working. Use this whenever you need to send the link again.

The token in `page_url` is the customer's credential: anyone holding the link can manage the subscription. Treat it like a password.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/page-link/' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY'"}</pre>
